messages:
Rohit: FYI - courier just dropped a weird oversized envelope + two small parcels at the lobby and asked to leave them with us. No return label on the big one.
Front Desk: Can you confirm recipient or department? I don't want to accept unidentified oversized deliveries.
Rohit: It has a handwritten note: 'office plant watering schedule & swag - do not open before standup'. No sender. Might be from partner event?
Sasha: 😂 someone sent us surprise swag + mystery plant? Please put the plant in the low-light shelf, its clearly a schefflera.
Front Desk: Ops checklist: hold unidentified package, photo front/back for records, put fragile tag if applicable, create locker hold.
ops-bot: Package scanned: PKG-900123. Photo uploaded: https://assets.redwood/co/PKG-900123.jpg. Status: HOLD.
June: I can swing by and check if it's for Marketing — they had an offsite last week. If not, I'll take custody and tag it 'satchel hold'.
Marcos: Also two contractors arriving at 11 — they asked about seating. The couch is currently free but might be claimed. Anybody want the couch or should I reserve the corner booth?
Rohit: Poll time: React with :couch: if contractors get couch, :coffee: for booth.
Sasha: :couch: (cozy vibes)
June: :coffee: (booth better for laptops)
Marcos: :couch:
Front Desk: Heads-up — visitor badges ready once names are in the kiosk. Reminder: contractors must show ID at sign-in.
June: Added names: A. Gomez, T. Nguyen under 'Vendor - BrightWave'.
ops-bot: Visitor badges issued: VB-2022 (A. Gomez), VB-2023 (T. Nguyen). Notice: guests must be escorted in common areas per policy.
Front Desk: About the oversized envelope - whoever picks it up must sign waiver since sender unknown. Please DM me to sign remotely if you want me to release.
Rohit: I'll take it. DM me instructions and I'll sign when I arrive. Thanks for scanning the photo, ops-bot.
Sasha: Also, tiny PSA: if you leave a badge at the desk, add a sticky with your name. We had a mystery badge last week.
Marcos: Noted. I'll bring a stack of post-its.
Front Desk: All set — plant in low-light shelf labeled 'Hold - PKG-900123', oversized envelope locked in locker B3 (code 3310). Visitors scheduled and seating decided (couch wins). Closing thread. :)
